dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It's rest time now, right? Why can't I get to sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Wait, no! That was it — we have something important to do in a minute, right...? Yeah, I can't sleep now!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ugh, but if I'm not well-rested when we head off, I'm gonna mess things up for sure. I really don't know what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I gathered the available data, did some analysis, and came up with some more effective battle strategies... Oh, I should write them down for her...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I wonder if she'll be surprised when she wakes up?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Well, sleepwalking time's almost up. Keep an eye on her in battle, won't you?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Maybe it would be nice to read something a little lighter for once. It would be a nice break from the academic texts I usually read — they give me such a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Hmm... Actually, maybe not. I can't afford to relax yet, or I'll end up missing my next thesis deadline...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I can't just rely on "The Stars' Blessing" to see me through. I have to put in the work myself!
